page.title: App configuration
page.subtitle: Toggle XePrime Partner app features and manage the plan guide email templates.

config.loadError: Could not load the app configuration.

isPlanPromotionEnabled.label: Enable plan promotion
isPlanPromotionEnabled.description: Show the plan list and the Contact for consultation button in the XePrime Partner app, and send plan sign-up/renewal guide emails (including when a shop registers on the web). Changes apply immediately to users who have the app open.

config.contactHint: Shown in the app and in the plan guide email. Leave empty if you do not use that channel.
config.zaloHint: This number is used for the "Contact for advice" link in plan guide emails (opens zalo.me).
config.contactInvalid: 6–20 characters, starting with a digit or +; digits, spaces, dots and hyphens only.
config.saved: Configuration saved. Open apps will receive the change right away.

templates.search: Search by set code or name

confirm.activateBody: Every plan guide email sent from now on will use this template. The template currently in use will be switched off.
confirm.deleteBody: A deleted template can no longer be used. This cannot be undone.

templates.error: Could not load the template list.

empty.title: No email templates yet
empty.hint: Create a template to send plan subscription and renewal guide emails.

templates.explain: The active set applies to every plan email; the system picks the content per case: Shop registration & Consultation request → Welcome; ≤ 7 days left → Expiring; Expiry day → Expired; During grace → Grace.

editor.loadError: Could not load the email template.
editor.codeHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; cannot be changed after creation.
editor.name: Template name
editor.subject: Email subject

validation.codeFormat: 2–60 characters: lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
validation.nameTooLong: Name must be at most {max} characters.
validation.subjectRequired: Enter a subject in both languages for every content.
validation.subjectTooLong: Subject must be at most {max} characters.
validation.bodyRequired: Enter a body in both languages for every content.
validation.bodyTooLong: Content must be at most {max} characters.

editor.created: Template created. You can now preview it and send a test email.
editor.conflictTitle: Someone else just edited this template
editor.conflictBody: Your draft is out of date. Reload the latest version (your unsaved changes will be lost) or copy your content out first.

placeholders.title: Available variables
placeholders.hint: Click to copy. Values are filled in and sanitised by the system.
placeholders.conditional: Show the text between the tags only when the variable has a value (hotline, grace period, fee %…), e.g.:
placeholders.planTable: Plan price table (HTML built by the system)
placeholders.purchaseUrl: Link to buy or renew a plan on the website
placeholders.zaloUrl: Consultation link: opens Zalo (https://zalo.me/…) when a Zalo number is set, otherwise the support page
placeholders.reminderDays: Days before expiry the reminder is sent (system setting)
placeholders.graceDays: Grace period of the plan in days (empty when the plan has none)
placeholders.graceEndsAt: Grace period end date (only for emails about an active plan)
placeholders.commissionPercent: Per-trip service fee % on the per-trip track (current fee policy)
placeholders.packageCommissionPercent: XePrime per-trip commission % on a shop plan

preview.title: Preview
preview.subject: Subject
preview.createFirst: Save the template once to preview it and send a test email.

editor.sendTestUsesSaved: The test email uses the SAVED version — save first if you just made changes.
editor.variantHelp: Every set has all four contents, each with a subject and body in both languages.
